subject: english
question:
The following sentence contains an error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

His aunt who lives at America brought a lot of gifts for him and his sister.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect preposition "at" instead of "in" before "America."
 
• "In" is the correct preposition to use when referring to living in a country.
 
• The correct phrase should be "who lives in America," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in this part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"His aunt who lives in America brought a lot of gifts for him and his sister."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "His aunt which lives" **– This option is incorrect because "which" should be "who" when referring to people.
 
• **Option 2: "lot of gifts by him" **– This option is incorrect because it changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "and her sister," **– This option is incorrect because it changes the possessive pronoun and does not address the main error.
 
• **Option 5: "The correct answer is option 3" **– This option is not an actual sentence correction.
